WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(derived_product_cost) as col_2,
    AVG(CASE WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL AND product_price != 0 
             THEN derived_total_cost / product_price 
             ELSE NULL END) as col_3
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(col_3) as col_1
  FROM step1
  WHERE col_3 IS NOT NULL
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.invoice_number,
    s1.col_2,
    s1.col_3,
    s1.col_3 - s2.col_1 as col_4
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.col_1 IS NOT NULL
    AND s1.col_3 IS NOT NULL
    AND s1.col_3 > s2.col_1
)
SELECT 
  AVG(col_2) as result_1,
  AVG(col_3) as result_2,
  AVG(col_4) as result_3
FROM step3
